items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'd like to ask you about that very first year. What kind of music did you have when you said it was in Congo Square with some people called Borrigan?

ctx.x: And Adrienne. Adrienne Rudolph. Rudolph. But Martha Saison is the star at Xavier Nair. She plays in all the concerts. Yeah. And so her father is a member with my husband of his lodge. And so he was so glad to ask his daughter. So we had a big concert instead of a tea. Everybody was sitting down. They were very much enjoyed by the tea we had.
I'd like to ask you about that very first year. What kind of music did you have when you said it was in Congo Square with some people called Borrigan?

What kind of music we had? We had Papa Salastare himself with Lizzie Miles singing. We had the best. The people start from the bottom up, but we had the best first. We had the best first. We've never had a concert like that since. But he donated his time. Well, I tell you how we got this Beauregard Square. Congo Square. I will call it Congo Square because I knew it by Congo Square. The Pops concert was going on. You know about the Pops concert. And so I went to see the mayor to ask for this square. And he was…
